body.x: SNOWSOUND(www.snowsoundusa.com) announced acoustic panel 'snowsound' at 'CES Unveiled' of the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

This panel momentarily pushing air into the pores, sound energy is significantly reduced. when acoustic waves travel above it. So, it can significantly improve room acoustics by reducing echoes. Panels are constructed with high quality, 100% recyclable, durable, thin, light weight, fire resistant.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance.More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
